contract.intent: Define and lock the Requirements-Change Protocol — how Ann handles changes to requirements (and any locked artifact) WITHOUT violating immutability: new amendment node → complete superseding artifact → superseded event → referrer re-pointing. Locked artifacts are never edited; --force rotation is stamp repair only.
acceptanceCriteria: Change-protocol artifact exists at artifacts/requirements-change-protocol.md — the full amendment path (trigger → spawn amendment node → gates → complete artifact → superseded event → referrer re-point)
Immutability rule stated hard: locked artifacts are byte-identical forever; content change = new complete artifact, never an edit; --force lock rotation = stamp/upstream-metadata repair only
Enforcement rule: the engine refuses writes to any artifact referenced as locked (validation error, not a workflow option)
Real-use-case framing: requirements change mid-project is the normal case, not an emergency
Spec locked (type=spec, upstream design v3 + requirements-spec + flow-control-spec + tree-format-spec-v2)
